no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Biomerica is a commercial-stage IVD (in-vitro diagnostics) company. Lead products are FDA 510(k)-cleared diagnostic test kits (inFoods IBS — diagnostic-guided therapy blood test for IBS food triggers; hp+detect — H. pylori detection). Pipeline expansion targets are additional inFoods diagnostic indications (Functional Dyspepsia, Crohn's, UC, GERD, Migraine, Depression, Osteoarthritis), all as DIAGNOSTIC tests, not drugs. No active investigational drug Phase 1/2/3 trials.

products: broad CE-marked / FDA-cleared IVD test kits
